benchmark_subset.Family A: 8-12 TRAIN scenarios spanning favored-long/favored-short, low/high skew, low/high utilization, both noise levels
benchmark_subset.Family B: 8 TRAIN scenarios spanning hog_count, late_pressure, slo_emphasis, hog/late TTFT variants
benchmark_subset.Family C: 8 TRAIN scenarios spanning bulk_pressure, urgent_arrival_phase, urgent_tightness
benchmark_subset.public_trace_sanity: optional 6 windows, expected no ANWG separation; used only to detect catastrophic timing/feasibility regression

candidate_policy: one low-dimensional DebtSchedulerPolicy with <=4 debt weights and <=4 thresholds selected before screening from coarse interpretable defaults; no optimizer/search beyond a tiny preregistered grid if needed
compute_budget: local CPU, target <5 minutes, no Wulver, no GPU, no FINAL, no TEST, no oracle labels, no selector training
hypothesis: A native accumulated debt scheduler adds positive marginal ANWG to the current six-policy envelope across at least two mechanism regions without collapsing to any parent policy.
inputs: existing TRAIN-only scenario generators or frozen TRAIN-design scenario subset spanning Family A fairness/starvation, Family B prefill/decode contention, Family C KV pressure, plus a small saturated public-trace sanity subset only if already labeled non-FINAL/non-TEST
metrics: mechanism diagnostics: debt service balance, SLO miss/near-miss, completion release, KV reserve violations
scope: Design only here; do not launch in this task.
